title: Cron auth fails closed off Vercel and the vitals endpoint is rate limited
detail:
An unset CRON_SECRET outside production lets 40+ cron routes through; /api/vitals is an unauthenticated service-role insert with no per-IP limit. Also add a header presence gate (see headers-gate).

Closed by SEC-011 (#3932): cron auth allows an unset secret only in development and test, and /api/vitals has a shared rate ceiling. The original small-hardening probe looked for VERCEL_ENV or ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_CRON in cron-auth.ts; the repair keys on NODE_ENV instead, so the probe is replaced with sec-cron-vitals.mjs, which asserts both halves.
